reasoning_summary: Selected features cover broad semantic groups relevant to credit risk including credit score, indebtedness, repayment behavior, delinquency, utilization, income capacity, and customer history. Features with low or no missingness and stable, interpretable credit-risk meaning were prioritized. Redundant features were controlled by preferring more interpretable and stable representatives within groups (e.g., fico_mean over fico_range_low/high). Features with high missingness or operational brittleness were excluded. Flags and bands were included selectively to capture stable categorical signals and missingness patterns. The selection balances stable out-of-time generalization, coverage, interpretability, and redundancy control to provide a broad candidate pool for downstream statistical selection.
